title: The body is cut after the head: the caller sees a truncated stream and a transport failure, and nothing is retried
notes: The declared length is 100 bytes while only the 13 bytes of `data: hello` plus its blank line are written; the server then closes, so the caller observes a body short of the declared length. Because the head already went out, the transport failure is not retried and the caller receives the stream error; the response log recording is aborted, so a replay of the same request must miss (the test asserts a nil replay).
